column1: # RNW regionIdent table — region code -> regionIdent (profile 1 / CCP)
# regionIdent = (profile<<10)|codeId ; all shipped RNW regions use profile 1 (folder CCP).
# Baked into osm2rnw (src/osm2rnw/src/main.rs REGION_IDENT). Derived from stock data, not guessed:
#   * primary evidence = regionIdent repeats ~1e3x in that region's own DATA/DATA/RNW/CCP/<code>/NAV_ROOT.DAT
#     vs ~1 elsewhere (NAV_ROOT histogram, owner-vs-foreign margin >= 8x), cross-checked against the
#     constant regionIdent inside that region's stock MAP shard .TCI clusterRefs (e.g. N6E211A.TCI = 0x42a);
#   * BNL/MLC: small/overlay regions, no dominant NAV_ROOT signal -> the two values left over from the
#     confirmed used-value set {1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14,17,18,22,42} once the other 15 are pinned
#     (BNL = dense Benelux .TCI shards, MLC = tiny counters);
#   * GRC = NAV_ROOT-clean (83% share) though no stock .TCI surfaced 0x406.
# NOTE: Poland's ROAD-network region is POL (0x402) — the krzeszowice/Krakow road clusters live under
#   CCP/POL (rnw2osm on CCP/POL yields ~5888 roads near Krakow; CCP/EEU yields 0), and stock shard
#   N6E2102.TCI references them with a uniform regionIdent 0x402. EEU (0x42a) is a SEPARATE aggregate
#   region (Hungary/Ukraine/Belarus) on the same MAP grid (shard N6E211A.TCI), NOT Poland's roads.
#   So swap targets for Poland use --region POL (-> 0x402). (An earlier note claiming "Poland=EEU" was wrong.)
# confidence: high except BNL/MLC (by elimination). Verify on-device before trusting an untested region.
